title: Verification budget
body: The required acceptance floor already includes reading package.json, src/waves.js, every test, implementing the focused change, and running the real `node --test` checker. Should I also run the smallest additional assurance increment—an independent integrity review of the final diff and test evidence (about 1 extra worker turn)?
